title: S2-Hammer V1.9 — fail-pattern report (30-minute contract)
question: Under the docs/RESEARCH_DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md section 5 standard report contract, what do the fail-pattern, 30-minute timing, BB/DXY/MTF context views show for S2-Hammer V1.9 (the Pullback-signal precursor, OOS-failed per docs/STRATEGY.md)?
hypothesis: This is a full-coverage fail-pattern reproduction, not a new hypothesis test; it exists as the V1.9 half of the RS-XAUUSD-20260727-008 gap report and as historical context for the S2 evolution.

findings.title: time_bleed, not immediate_loss, dominates S2 losses
findings.detail: 71 of 132 losses (53.8%) are time_bleed (held ≥24 bars / 12h before stopping out) — the opposite pattern from S1, where entries fail fast or work. S2 is a mean-reversion strategy: it drags losers rather than failing instantly (only 15.9% immediate_loss).

findings.title: Low win rate is expected for this strategy shape
findings.detail: WR 41.07% with PF 1.535 — a left-side reversal strategy compensates for a sub-50% win rate with a larger average win than average loss (avg PnL $31.75/trade).

findings.title: MTF counter-trend penalty is much smaller than S1's
findings.detail: 4H-bearish counter-trend WR 38.2% vs 42.96% aligned (4.76pp gap) — far narrower than S1 V3.4's 9.6pp gap, consistent with S2 being designed to fade the trend rather than follow it.

findings.title: Superseded strategy version
findings.detail: V1.9 failed OOS validation (docs/STRATEGY.md) and is not the active formal S2 version (V3.2 is, owner-confirmed 2026-07-27). This report is historical/comparison context; see RS-XAUUSD-20260727-007 for the current version and RS-XAUUSD-20260727-008 for the version gap.
